Checked claim · serial-real-energy-factor

The real homogeneous neo-Hookean energy has the exact nonnegative-factor form.

Assumptions: Real mu; lambda>0.

theorem energy_factor (mu l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) :
    energy mu l = mu / (2 * l) * (l - 1) ^ 2 * (l + 2)

Limits: W=mu/(2*lambda)*(lambda-1)^2*(lambda+2); signs are not assumed in this algebraic identity. Real local homogeneous incompressible material law only; no JavaScript refinement, numerical root or mesh-volume validation, continuous stepped-solid interface, global stability, bulk-penalty calibration or anatomical claim.
